capabilities: Render interactive CircuitJS simulations from circuitjs code blocks in Reading view
Run simulations offline using a bundled copy of CircuitJS (desktop only)
Open circuits in the full CircuitJS browser app via an edit link
Configure editability, CircuitJS URL, and the code block tag in settings
extras: Offline mode is desktop-only (Electron webview); mobile users must disable it and use the remote CircuitJS URL. Changes made in the embedded simulation are not saved back to the code block and must be re-exported manually.
motivation: The README states the plugin 'bridges the gap between circuit design and documentation', keeping circuits in version control, backed up, and organized within the knowledge base.
problem: Circuit designs sketched in CircuitJS live outside the vault, so they cannot be stored, versioned, backed up, or viewed alongside the Markdown notes that document them.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian.md plugin to embed CircuitJS circuit simulations directly into your notes.

summary: Embeds interactive CircuitJS circuit simulations into notes via fenced code blocks, with offline mode and links to edit in the full browser app.
